turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on a, an and the?
turns.tutor:
Yes! One example first.
He has ___ pen. "Pen" starts with "p". Not a vowel sound. So: He has a pen.
The rule: "a" before most sounds; "an" before vowel sounds like a, e, i, o, u.
Right: She eats an apple. Wrong: She eats a apple.
Your try. Write a or an: She has ___ orange in her bag. (answer with only the missing word)
